name: kannada-arc-c-2.5k
description: Kannada-ARC-C-2.5k is a Kannada-language subset of the ARC (AI2 Reasoning Challenge) multiple-choice science questions, containing ~2.5k question items. It measures elementary-to-middle-school science reasoning in Kannada, evaluating model ability to answer curriculum-style science questions in a low-resource language. The dataset is intended for benchmarking multilingual and Indic-language QA and reasoning systems.
reputation: Part of the Indic-Benchmark collection; useful for low-resource language evaluation though less widely used than English ARC variants.
